_doc: One entry per acts/meta pair. data.py builds the checkpoint list from whichever entries have both files present;
a new extraction is added by appending an entry here, not by editing code. Check a new pair first with
python src/probe_cmp/validate.py --source <name>  (or --acts/--meta/--kind for a file not yet registered).
kind: 'position' = one row per (trace, checkpoint) at an absolute count of generated tokens observed (pos_col);
'end' = one row per trace at its last generated token.
name_col (optional, position kind): column holding the checkpoint label, e.g. a fraction; defaults to pos_col.
token_index: 'pos-1' = state at trace token index pos-1, i.e. after pos tokens (extract.py EXTRACTOR_VERSION 2);
'answer_end' = last token whose start offset lies after </think> (extract.py steps mode, last step).
layer_convention: 'hidden_states[l+1]' = layer l is HF output_hidden_states[l + 1]; l=-1 is the embedding output,
l=27 is the final hidden state after the model's last RMSNorm.
prefix: 'meta:<col>' = text up to the checkpoint stored in that meta column; 'trace' = full trace text (end only);
'tokenize' = decode the first pos tokens of the retokenized trace (needs transformers).
